programme.desc: S2:E7 Pingu construit une tour | Pingu le roi | Pingu le boulanger - Pingu voit dans un livre une tour qui monte jusqu'au ciel et veut en construire une identique. | Pinga découvre un livre sur les royaumes et Pingu pense que ce serait génial d'être roi. | Pingu veut faire son propre gâteau.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E8 Pingu et la poupée | Pingu aide grand-père | La mauvaise journée de Pingu
programme.desc: S2:E8 Pingu et la poupée | Pingu aide grand-père | La mauvaise journée de Pingu - Le bras de l'ours de Pinga se détache quand Pingu joue avec. | Pingu part à pied aider grand-père à cause des retards de la motoneige. | Pingu trébuche sur ses jouets, fait un mauvais trajet jusqu'à l'école et ne sait pas répondre au maître.

programme.title: En couple avec Sam et Freddie
programme.desc: Sam et Freddie sortent ensemble pour la plus grande joie de Carly qui est ravie de voir ses deux amis amoureux après s'être détestés toutes ces années.

programme.title: En couple avec Sam et Freddie
programme.desc: Sam et Freddie sortent ensemble pour la plus grande joie de Carly qui est ravie de voir ses deux amis amoureux après s'être détestés toutes ces années.

programme.title: Insupportable!
programme.desc: La relation entre Sam et Freddie commence à peser sur tout le monde ! Gibby devient le souffre-douleur attitré de Sam, Carly se fait évincer de la caméra, et aussi des sorties avec ses amies.

programme.title: Je taime
programme.desc: Carly suggère à Freddie et Sam de passer plus de temps ensemble et d'apprendre à se connaître. Sam ira donc jouer au petit train avec Freddie et ses copains et Freddie accompagnera Sam visiter son oncle et son cousin en prison. Mais c'est un échec.

programme.title: Lintello
programme.desc: Carly rencontre Kyle, un garçon très intelligent. Pour ne pas paraître stupide à ses yeux, elle étudie et fait des recherches sur Internet avant leur rendez-vous.

programme.title: rencontre la Première Dame des États-Unis
programme.desc: Carly se réjouit de revoir son père qui rentre fêter son anniversaire avec elle et Spencer. Malheureusement, la jeune fille déchante très vite quand elle apprend que son père ne pourra finalement pas rentrer.

programme.title: Nora, à la folie Pt1
programme.desc: Incarcérée pour avoir kidnappé et torturé la bande d'iCarly, Nora Dershlit est sur le point d'obtenir une libération conditionnelle.

programme.title: Nora, à la folie Pt2
programme.desc: Incarcérée pour avoir kidnappé et torturé la bande d'iCarly, Nora Dershlit est sur le point d'obtenir une libération conditionnelle.

programme.title: Grosses galères et gâteaux gras
programme.desc: Sam n'a pas fait de bêtise depuis 10 jours. En récompense, ses amis lui offrent une visite guidée d'une fabrique de gâteaux gras canadiens, ses pâtisseries préférées.

programme.title: Plein les yeux
programme.desc: Freddie est frustré de n'être qu'un technicien. Il rêve de participer à l'aspect artistique de l'émission. Carly devant s'absenter pour le week-end, Sam accepte à contrecoeur de le laisser présenter iCarly avec elle.

programme.title: Christopher Cane présente
programme.desc: Christopher Cane (l'acteur anglais qui joue le rôle de Rex dans Victorious) reçoit l'équipe d'iCarly dans son émission.

programme.title: Lépidémie One Direction
programme.desc: Carly attrape une maladie contagieuse et contamine un membre des One Direction accidentellement.

programme.title: Le restaurant
programme.desc: Avec l'aide de Sam, Gibby ouvre un restaurant secret dans le sous-sol de l'école.

programme.title: Poisson davril
programme.desc: Carly et Spencer évoquent les événements du passé, alors qu'ils sont sur le point d'être renvoyés le jour du Poisson d'avril.

programme.title: Pear Store
programme.desc: Freddie obtient un emploi dans un magasin Pear, mais Sam obtient le même poste.

programme.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
programme.desc: Un malin renard utilise son ingéniosité pour tirer profit de trois fermiers faibles d'esprit qui se résolvent à utiliser des tactiques extrêmes pour protéger leurs poulets...

programme.title: La petite princesse et le dragon
programme.desc: Le jour de ses 7 ans, la Princesse Barbara découvre un livre magique qui la transporte dans un univers merveilleux rempli de créatures fantastiques.

programme.title: Les Z'intrus
programme.desc: Un ado réalise sa destinée en menant frère, sœur et cousins dans une bataille contre des extraterrestres qui utilisent leur maison de vacances pour planifier une invasion.

programme.title: Ursli, l'enfant des montagnes
programme.desc: Un garçon doit braver la neige profonde de l'hiver pour obtenir un précieux souvenir de famille. Avant même de pouvoir commencer ce difficile voyage, il doit d'abord aider sa famille à survivre à la ruine financière, sauver sa chèvre bien-aimée...

programme.title: Apparence Trompeuse
programme.desc: Sarah Daniels, la doyenne de l'université de Nouvelle-Angleterre, doit faire face à une terrible situation sur son campus. En effet, un crime à caractère raciste vient d'être commis. Dans une position très gênante, elle va devoir aller au-delà de ses propres préjugés afin de tenter de retrouver le coupable...

programme.title: Turbo Kid
programme.desc: Dans un futur dévasté, Kid part sauver son amie Apple, kidnappée par le tyran Zeus. Au cours d'une aventure aussi violente que déjantée, il devra trouver le courage de devenir un véritable héros.

programme.title: Hatch : Protection Rapprochée
programme.desc: Un ancien agent d'Interpol reprend les armes pour protéger le fils d'un informateur assassiné, alors qu'une guerre des gangs éclate dans les rues. Une mission à haut risque, une promesse à tenir, et une lutte sans merci pour survivre.

programme.title: Suicide Tourist
programme.desc: Condamné par une maladie incurable, un détective enquête dans un hôtel où les clients viennent mettre fin à leurs jours. Une affaire énigmatique qui l'oblige à affronter sa propre mortalité.

programme.title: Two Warriors : le combat du siècle
programme.desc: Un champion de boxe japonais jusque là invaincu se prépare à affronter un challenger américain. Sur fond de tensions politiques, le parcours parallèle des deux athlètes les poussera jusque dans leurs derniers retranchements.

programme.title: 5 est le numéro parfait
programme.desc: Un an après avoir surpassé le FBI, les 4 Cavaliers reviennent pour dénoncer un magnat criminel. Ignorant son piège, ils doivent braquer un système informatique sécurisé.

programme.title: La guerre de l'ombre
programme.desc: En 1980, à Belfast, Martin McGartland, 22 ans, doit choisir entre l'IRA et les services secrets britanniques. Il opte pour les Anglais malgré le danger.

programme.title: Taj Mahal
programme.desc: Louise a dix-huit ans lorsque son père doit partir à Bombay pour son travail. En attendant d'emménager dans une maison, la famille est d'abord logée dans une suite du Taj Mahal Palace où une attaque terrorriste a lieu.

programme.title: Assault sur Wall Street
programme.desc: Jim mène une vie paisible à New York avec sa famille et un bon travail. Quand l'économie s'effondre, il perd tout et décide de se venger en attaquant le système.

programme.title: Regarder Oana
programme.desc: Oana travaille. Et moi je la regarde. Ce soir, ce dernier dossier sera plié. Elle ne veut plus traduire les mots des autres. Elle pense que demain elle va commencer à écrire pour elle. Mais elle ne le fera pas. Je le sais....

programme.title: Bleu-Gris
programme.desc: Fin août. Corse. Elbe, dix-sept ans, sourde de naissance est en vacances chez sa grande sœur Mathilde. Un jour, alors qu'elle se rend au phare de la Revellata, elle aperçoit un homme qui remonte seul d'une plongée sous marine…

programme.title: Rase campagne
programme.desc: Un village perdu dans la campagne finistérienne. Un homme est suspecté d'être porteur du virus Ebola. Il est noir. C'est Maurice. Son meilleur ami, Michel, ambulancier, sillonne le territoire avec son stagiaire Rémi pour le retrouver et le contrôler…

programme.title: Les amoureuses
programme.desc: Sara a quinze ans elle passe ses journées d'été au bord de la piscine accompagnée de sa mère, de sa petite sœur et de ses copines. La fin du mois d'août sera traversée par la rencontre d'un jeune homme, Lilian, pour lequel Sara et sa mère éprouvent le même désir.

programme.title: La virée à Paname
programme.desc: Mourad, vingt ans, vivote entre cours de théâtre, sorties entre potes et petite copine. Ce jour-là, il décide de quitter son quartier pour se rendre à un atelier d'écriture, à Paris. Mais la démarche va s'avérer plus compliquée que prévu.

programme.title: Toutes les belles choses
programme.desc: Le jour se lève. Tout le monde dort, sauf la mariée, Jessica. Elle est bientôt rejointe par Cathy, qui ne dort pas non plus. Ce sont les plus vieilles amies de la terre et elles vont passer un peu de temps ensemble, ce matin.

programme.title: La répétition
programme.desc: Stéphane rêve de devenir comédien. Carole, elle, rêve d'une augmentation.

programme.title: Spotted
programme.desc: Un fugitif se fait intercepter par deux douaniers crapuleux alors qu'il tentait d'échapperà son destin. Au cours d'un interrogatoire musclé, Big Mike et son sous-fifre s'efforcent de démenteler son réseau clandestin et de mettre fin à ses rêves de liberté.

programme.title: Retrosexe
programme.desc: 2065.Persuadés que le sexe c'était mieux avant, une bande d'adolescents part sur les traces du Retrosexe.

programme.title: Dans le nez
programme.desc: “Dans le nez” est une histoire d'amour, de dégoût et de chimie volatile. Un conte où les montagnes sont des flacons, les aisselles des sources et les fantômes des parfums.

programme.title: Braise
programme.desc: Lors d'une soirée bien arrosée, un jeune homme trompe sa copine avec une jolie et exubérante Anglaise. Trois de leurs amis observent et commentent cette aventure. Un parallèle se crée entre cette conversation et l'étreinte des deux amants.

programme.title: L'amour libre
programme.desc: Dans un café parisien, deux bonnes amies, l'une célibataire et l'autre en union libre, se réunissent pour faire le point sur leur vie et leurs amours.

programme.title: Papa oom mow mow
programme.desc: Rouen, 1986. Par ennui, par amour, par opportunité (ou par miracle), Frank subit un choc capillaire, qui change sa triste vie dans sa pluvieuse ville...

programme.title: Tous les garçons aiment ça
programme.desc: Un adolescent retrouve sa copine pour le week-end. Ils ont décidé de faire l'amour. Les parents sont absents et rien ne devrait empêcher leur première fois. Enfin, si l'on est dans un teenage movie...

programme.title: Flow
programme.desc: John, un jeune bodybuilder, se prépare jour après jour pour une compétition, les NPC Georgia Bodybulding Championships. Sa vie est un rituel, une mécanique parfaitement réglée. Concentré sur son objectif, il ne lâche rien, espérant atteindre sur scène cet instant de bonheur unique : le flow.

programme.title: La femme à cordes
programme.desc: Sébastien, un jeune homme d'une vingtaine d'années, entre dans un petit théâtre sur les conseils d'un inconnu. Gogol l'invite à regarder son show. Ce dernier s'amuse à malmener une femme devant un parterre médusé. Sébastien s'interpose, sans connaître les règles du jeu.

programme.title: On the road...
programme.desc: « On the road to paradise » raconte la rencontre improbable dans un restoroute d'une serveuse au bord de la crise de nerfs, d'un camionneur collectionneur de routiers et d'une jeune femme en pleine rupture amoureuse. Tous les trois partagent sans le savoir, le même secret : ils viennent d'assassiner un homme. Un policier entre alors dans le restaurant...

programme.title: Flesh
programme.desc: L'Empire dévoile tout mais ne voit rien. Ses ennemis idéalisent tout mais ne tolèrent rien. L'orgasme terrestre des putains cathodiques pour les uns. L'orgasme éternel des 70 vierges paradisiaques pour les autres. Et si la chair était seule au monde ?

programme.title: Miniyamba
programme.desc: Comme des dizaines de milliers de personnes qui chaque jour dans le monde quittent leur terre natale, Abdu, un jeune malien, a décidé de gagner l'Europe. Un voyage du fleuve niger aux barbelés de l'enclave de Ceuta, où les rêves se confrontent à la dure réalité des migrants, avec au loin les lumières de l'occident.

programme.title: Je suis fan de mon voisin
programme.desc: Georges vie sa vie tranquillement, sans savoir que son voisin l'imite...

programme.title: Far away: les soldats de l'espoir
programme.desc: Inspiré d'une histoire vraie. Jun Shik travaille à la ferme du grand-père de Tatsuo alors que la Corée est colonisée par le Japon, mais il rêve de participer aux Jeux olympiques de Tokyo en tant que coureur de marathon. Tatsuo vise également à devenir marathonien, ce qui crée une rivalité entre eux. Mais la guerre éclate et ils sont tous deux forcés de s'enrôler dans l'armée. Tatsuo devient chef de la défense dans l'unité de Jun Shik et élabore un plan qui échoue. Jun Shik et Tatsuo sont capturés par les Soviétiques. Ils s'échappent mais sont rapidement capturés par les Allemands et forcés de se séparer. En 1944, ils se retrouvent sur les plages de Normandie.

programme.title: Les Derniers Survivants
programme.desc: Au bord d'une vaste vallée aride, tout ce qui reste de la Wallace Farm for Wayward Youth, ce sont quelques carcasses de bâtiments abandonnés. Kendal, dix-sept ans (Haley Lu Richardson), se souvient à peine de l'époque où la vallée de l'Oregon était encore verdoyante. Cela fait dix ans qu'il n'a pas plu, et la société s'est littéralement évaporée. Kendal et les rares survivants subsistent tant bien que mal, rêvant de s'échapper. Lorsqu'un baron cupide de l'eau revendique ce qu'il reste de cette précieuse ressource souterraine, Kendal doit choisir entre fuir et se cacher ou se battre courageusement pour les quelques personnes et choses qui lui sont chères.

programme.title: L'Affaire CIA
programme.desc: Un ancien employé de CIA découvre un complot mortel tout en essayant de sauver sa fille qui a été enlevée.

programme.title: Mega Piranha
programme.desc: Une souche mutante de piranhas géants et féroces s'échappe de l'Amazonie et se fraie un chemin vers la Floride.

programme.title: Black sea
programme.desc: Récemment renvoyé par sa société, un capitaine de sous-marin est embauché pour trouver un trésor gisant au fond de la mer.

programme.title: The Little Unicorn
programme.desc: Un conte de fées moderne vraiment enchanteur, avec des effets spéciaux époustouflants. La vie heureuse de la jeune Polly et de son grand-père est bouleversée par la mort de son cheval préféré et la naissance magique d'un bébé licorne dans leur ferme. Lorsque le village découvre son secret, certains de ses personnages les plus rusés tentent de voler la créature mystique.

programme.title: Ratchet Et Clank
programme.desc: Ratchet et Clank unissent leur force, intelligence et courage pour lutter contre le maléfique Drek qui veut détruire la galaxie. Avec l'aide des Rangers Galactiques ils vont se lancer dans une aventure spectaculaire ! Ce duo de choc est basé sur la franchise des jeux vidéo Ratchet & Clank de Sony, qui a été écoulée à plus de 13 millions d'exemplaires à travers le monde.

programme.title: Le Majordome
programme.desc: Léopold, valet de chambre d'un vieil avocat en fin de carrière, mène une double vie. Grâce à sa connaissance du code pénal, il est un «juge» très apprécié et respecté de la pègre parisienne. Le docteur Ventoux, alias «le Chat», un cambrioleur célèbre pour son agilité, sollicite sa collaboration pour un gros coup. Léopold, qui bénéficie d'une solide expérience dans les commandos, accepte et recrute une petite équipe qu'il soumet à un dur entraînement. Au cours d'une soirée donnée par le procureur, il fait la connaissance d'Agnès, la fiancée de Ventoux, et s'en éprend. Afin d'arracher la jeune femme au «Chat», il décide de saboter le hold-up...

programme.title: High School U.s.a.
programme.desc: Dans une classe de terminale, J.J. poursuit la petite amie d'un rival d'une classe supérieure.

programme.title: Borat, nouvelle mission filmée
programme.desc: Dans cette suite hilarante, le quatrième meilleur journaliste du Kazakhstan, Borat Sagdiyev, doit offrir un "cadeau" au vice-président américain.

programme.title: Amour & Amnésie
programme.desc: Un homme tombe amoureux d'une femme qui souffre de graves troubles de la mémoire à court terme.

programme.title: Waiting for the barbarians
programme.desc: La prise de conscience d'un magistrat d'une petite ville coloniale après avoir été témoin des mauvais traitements subis par les prisonniers de guerre.

programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: Un avocat aveuglé par des déchets radioactifs combat le crime comme un superhéros acrobate des arts martiaux, en utilisant ses autres sens, qui ont été affûtés.

programme.title: Le Temps des mots, le temps d'aimer
programme.desc: Paige écrit sous un pseudonyme pour sauver la maison d'édition de sa mère, en le cachant à l'éditeur Daniel.

programme.title: L'amour en coffret
programme.desc: Lillian conseille la start-up de Grant, mais son passé amoureux risque de chambouler ses sentiments.

programme.title: Une mère diabolique
programme.desc: Jessica, ruinée, tente de récupérer sa fille Allison pour toucher son héritage de 40 millions d'euros.

programme.title: Gentleman menteur
programme.desc: Julie, veuve, est séduite par Martin, un arnaqueur pro qui s'immisce dans sa vie et celle de son fils.

programme.title: The Wash
programme.desc: Alors que son loyer est dû et sa voiture immobilisée par un sabot, Sean (Dr. Dre) doit trouver une solution, et vite. Quand son meilleur pote et colocataire Dee Loc (Snoop Dogg) fait embaucher Sean dans la sociéte de lavage de voiture locale, son sens des affaires impressionne Mr Washington (George Wallace), le patron du lavage auto, adepte des armes à feu et des dominos.

programme.title: Amityville III: Le démon
programme.desc: La redoutable maison d'Amityville est de nouveau agitée par la terreur. John Baxter, un journaliste sceptique, est le dernier acheteur de la maison la plus effrayante sur terre malgré la légende voulant que cette demeure soit hantée. Alors que Lisa l'aide dans la recherche de la vérité au sujet de cette maison, le couple découvre qu'il serait préférable que certains endroits restent inexplorés.

programme.title: Amityville: The Awakening
programme.desc: Une mère célibataire emménage avec ses trois enfants dans une maison hantée, sans connaître son histoire sanglante.

programme.title: The Grudge
programme.desc: Une infirmière américaine vivant à Tokyo est exposée à une mystérieuse malédiction surnaturelle qui rend une personne enragée avant de prendre sa vie et de se répandre à une nouvelle victime.

programme.title: The Grudge 2
programme.desc: La suite du film d'horreur du même nom, avec Amber Tamblyn et Arielle Kebbel. À Tokyo, la sœur d'une jeune fille victime d'une malédiction qui lui a ôté la vie en devient elle aussi accidentellement la victime. Avec l'aide d'un jounaliste, elle doit trouver comment y mettre fin une fois pour toutes.

programme.title: Les mots retrouvés
programme.desc: Une fille de onze ans issue d'une famille difficile fait preuve d'un don incroyable presque surnaturel pour les mots lorsqu'elle remporte le concours régional d'orthographe et se qualifie pour celui national. L'attention est soudainement portée sur elle.

programme.title: Belleville Tokyo
programme.desc: Un couple se dirige vers un train en partance pour Venise. Sur le quai, Julien annonce à Marie qu'il part en rejoindre une autre et s'en va, la laissant seule à Paris, enceinte. Bouleversée, Marie se refuse à être victime de cette situation.

programme.title: Big divorce
programme.desc: Mike a signé un accord prénuptial à toute épreuve et sa femme ne le laissera pas sortir du mariage.

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: On retrouve ici trois générations de légendes de la comédie. Le patron de boîte de nuit Sugar Ray (Richard Pryor) et son fils Quick (Eddie Murphy) se battent pour empêcher un dangereux gangster et une police corrompue de faire couler leur boîte.

programme.desc: Voix ouf met en avant le monde du doublage et les artistes cachés derrière nos héros préférés.

Mais Alex ne revoit Isabel que trois mois après, quand elle lui apprend qu'elle est enceinte. Sur un coup de tête, il la demande en mariage. Mais Alex et Isabel découvrent très vite qu'un mariage ne se résume pas qu'à une chapelle à Las Vegas et un imitateur d'Elvis.

programme.desc: Les fourmis sont les véritables vedettes de ce buddy-movie qui rend un hommage direct aux films de monstres des années 50. Inspiré du cultissime jeu vidéo des années 80 It came from the desert ce film déjanté est un fabuleux mélange de fourmis géantes et de courses de moto dans le désert… Nouveau Mexique - Se rendant à une Keg Party où la bière coule à flots nos 2 coureurs de motocross vont faire une rencontre inattendue en tombant par hasard sur un ancien site militaire. Des expérimentations secrètes visant à croiser leur l'ADN avec des débris d'une métérorite trouvée en 1951 ont été menées sur des fourmis et araignées….et qui ont donné naissance à des fourmis géantes mutantes !

L'armée américaine a pris le contrôle du laboratoire sur ordre de la sécurité nationale et, peu après, a mis en place des mesures visant à militariser l'entité. Les détails des événements inexplicables qui s'y sont produits sont rendus publics après être restés classifiés pendant près de quarante ans.

programme.desc: Ewa a onze ans. Elle vit dans une petite ville délaissée. C'est une enfant à part, isolée. Et pour cause, elle est persuadée d'être une vampire. Fascinée par Hugo, seize ans, elle rêve d'en faire un vampire lui aussi, et ainsi vaincre sa solitude.

Pour une plongée dans l'horreur, aussi.

Lorsqu'il découvre un secret enfoui depuis longtemps et capable de changer le monde, les plus hautes instances décident que c'est à son tour d'être traqué et éliminé. Son seul espoir est de retrouver Rick Deckard, un ancien Blade Runner qui a disparu depuis des décennies...

Voulant impressionner sa nouvelle copine, il demande à Miyagi, un maître en arts martiaux, de lui enseigner le karaté.

programme.title: Boy George on AI, Spirituality & Why Jealousy Is Pointless
programme.desc: Boy George joins Fearne to discuss ego, jealousy, fame, grief and the mindset shift that changed everything. From embracing the Three Principles to tapping every morning, he explains how learning to pause before reacting helped him let go of resentment and feel lighter than ever. He opens up about loving fame and why he'd do it differently if he could start again, AI, and why "hating someone is completely pointless".

programme.title: Philippa Perry On Why Everyone Has an Inner Critic
programme.desc: Psychotherapist and author Philippa Perry discusses why everyone has an inner critic and how to stop believing yours. Philippa explains why not feeling 'good enough' is often less about truth and more about habit. She shares how to tell the difference between a helpful critical inner voice and a self-sabotaging one, and why negative thought patterns keep us stuck.

programme.title: Sam Thompson On His Anxiety And Undiagnosed ADHD
programme.desc: Sam Thompson discusses how anxiety and undiagnosed ADHD have shaped his relationships and self-confidence. He shares his experience of panic attacks, including one on the first day of I'm A Celebrity, and talks about therapy, the patterns he kept repeating, and his three go-to people during crises. Sam and Fearne debate people-pleaser approaches to leaving parties and discuss behind-the-scenes stories from his content creation work. Sam also reveals why he was willing to pay to appear on I'm A Celebrity.

programme.title: Sam Claflin Asks What Is Body Dysmorphia?
programme.desc: Actor Sam Claflin discusses his lifelong struggle with body dysmorphia and body image with Fearne Cotton. Sam explains what having body dysmorphia means to him and how it affects everything from the food he eats to his willingness to watch his own films back. Fearne and Sam discuss being chronic people pleasers and how they're working to stop putting everyone else's comfort before their own. Sam reflects on how he was brought up to think about masculinity and what he's doing to ensure his own son grows up with gentler male role models. They also reminisce about the early days of MSN and webcam chatrooms.

programme.title: Chris Appleton: From Being Bullied to Styling the Kardashians
programme.desc: Celebrity hair stylist Chris Appleton chats with Fearne about why we change our hair when we want to start over. Chris explains that everyone from the Kardashians to cancer patients have opened up to him about their insecurities, and he's seen the profound impact that looking more like yourself on the outside can have on how you feel about yourself on the inside. He's fascinated by the self-limiting beliefs people have about who they are. Chris has dealt with a lot of his own shame and fears too. He was bullied at school, struggled to acknowledge his sexuality, and had huge imposter syndrome when he first arrived in Hollywood. He also gives Fearne a consultation about going bolder with her hair. Content warning: this episode contains frank conversation about suicidal ideation.

programme.title: Jimmy Carr on Feminism, Parenting, and Success
programme.desc: Comedian Jimmy Carr discusses defining success without comparing yourself to others, the importance of hard work, and why he doesn't fear cancel culture. He explains his views on feminism and motherhood, why he refuses to use the term "babysitting" for parenting his own children, and how his anxieties fuel his comedy.

programme.title: Nafessa Williams On Racism, Sexism, and Rivals
programme.desc: Rivals actress Nafessa Williams discusses playing the only black woman in a white man's world in 1980s Britain, and how she sees her acting as her contribution to activism and representation. She explores what it means to be on a TV show with intimate scenes, the journey from law to acting, manifestation and taking action, faith and optimism, and the importance of rest alongside ambition.

programme.title: JOE Pub Quiz with TommyInnit and Max Fosh
programme.desc: TommyInnit and Max Fosh go head-to-head in the Joe Pub Quiz with a YouTube twist, battling it out across rounds testing their knowledge of the platform, iconic YouTube moments and some of the biggest names in internet history. From guessing who said which iconic line, to throwback YouTube apologies from Logan Paul, classic Sidemen diss tracks and a final rapid-fire round where they have to identify famous YouTubers from photos. Along the way, Tommy and Max also get into some of the biggest debates in YouTube history, including whether we need to bring proper YouTube apologies back, the golden era of diss tracks and what KSI leaving the Sidemen means for them.

programme.title: When Did Elon Musk Lose His Mind?
programme.desc: When did Elon Musk make the jump from salesman to supervillain? Quinn Slobodian and Ben Tarnoff trace Musk's journey from tech billionaire to stalwart of the online right. From his upbringing in apartheid South Africa to the rise of Tesla and SpaceX, they detail his changing views on AI and the "woke mind virus", as well as his eventual alliance with Donald Trump. Slobodian and Tarnoff examine his industrial philosophy, what led him to the White House, his purchase of Twitter, and his various attempts to further fuse technology into our lives.

programme.title: CRISTINA & JORGE
programme.desc: Two elements characterize the wedding of Cristina and Jorge: their Cuban heritage and perfectly executed pops of color. It's important to the couple that the food is incredible, and since they're in South Beach, Florida, their chef incorporates Cuban spices and fruits into a steak and lobster dinner to create a modern “Floribbean” feast. The décor has an elegant, clean look with a lot of black and white, while drama comes from fuchsia accents. Crystal-filled vases are topped with a stunning cube-shaped design of 600 bright pink double dianthus flowers per centerpiece. And the wedding cake is one-of-a-kind: layers of cake draped in black fondant fronted with fuchsia and white rectangles alternate with layers of acrylic boxes filled with crystals!

programme.title: Swamp Bride
programme.desc: What is David Tutera to do with a bride who is allergic to flowers and wants her wedding décor to resemble a swamp? This is a first for David, and with only three weeks until the wedding, he's going to either sink or swim. His first challenge is to get his head strong bride to agree to change out her wedding gown. Not easy. And as for the bridesmaid's dresses that look like lily pads? Oh yes, they are second to go! Since David's bride has such a unique vision for her big day, he's on a quest for one-of-a-kind wedding favors. Favors that have to include frogs – yes, frogs. And finally, it's time to face the challenge of what food to serve at this wedding, so what better than a yummy food tasting. And when the big day finally arrives, our bride has all of Manhattan as a backdrop and fireworks to finalize a magical day.

programme.title: Diva Bride
programme.desc: They say everything is bigger in Texas, and so is the personality of David Tutera's new Dallas bride. When she says “diva”, you better say ‘licious” , because she's a force to be reckoned with. How do you combine Lady Gaga, Beyonce, Mardi Gras and pink feathers into a wedding? With three weeks until the big day, David decides to make everything off the charts! Glittery, glamorous reception dresses for not only the bride but the bridesmaids as well. And nothing says “diva” like an over-the-top photo shoot! And what better location for this production, than a theater complete with a red carpet entrance!

programme.title: Cowgirl Bride
programme.desc: With many brides, the dress is the most important thing for her wedding. But with David Tutera's next bride – it's all about the cowboy boots! This Texas cowgirl is dead set on two stepping her way into the sunset, and David is determined to have her step into a pair of nice heels! The challenges start with giving the bride a sophisticated gown to wear – with or without boots! And speaking of boots, how about bridal boot camp to get into shape for the big day? A picture-perfect Texas ranch transforms into the ideal setting for our country bride to dance the night away under the stars.

programme.title: Pirate Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera has planned plenty of destination weddings, so when he heard about a Caribbean wedding, the last thing he thought it would be was, “pirates of the Caribbean”! David's latest bride, Brooke Lewis loves the idea of pirates, but instead of planning an elegant wedding, it's turning into a 5-year-olds birthday party! So her décor and venue are the first to go when David takes over the planning. Brooke gets a beautiful and romantic wedding gown, and the bridesmaids are decked out in jewel-toned dresses. And since this bride is a true treasure, she needs to wear stunning jewels – how about $250,000 worth? And just when she thinks the surprises are done, David takes her on a little climbing expedition. Something that will make her trust her wedding planner as well as letting off a little steam.

programme.title: Butterfly Bride
programme.desc: Where does David Tutera begin with a bride who wants butterflies, rainbows, butterflies and then more butterflies? Monique Villegas is a sweet bride who loves colors and whimsy but has no idea how to pull off a wedding. With only 3 weeks before her big day, David takes charge, and the magic begins. Rainbows are captured in the Swarovski crystal jewelry that our bride tries on. And how about a champagne toast at sunset in a private jet, flying high above Los Angeles to make a brides dreams come true?

When all else fails, Samantha gets the idea of using sleep therapy to reunite the Kravitzes. Then she awakens them and each begins looking for the other. Later, as Samantha and Darrin look forward to spending an evening at home alone, the Kravitzes arrive to celebrate their reunion.

Samantha can't explain why she and Endora were changing his features, and Darrin begins to worry. As the obsession grows, Samantha decides to build up her husband's ego. Changing her own personality, Samantha becomes a French sculptress, Michelle. She tells Darrin his face exudes the masculine appeal she has always tried to find in a model. Darrin turns down Michelle's request that he pose for her, suspecting that she is Samantha. A substitute secretary, Barbara Lucas, appears at the office and Darrin, thinking it is another of Samantha's tricks, makes a play for her, just as Samantha walks in. Her jealous reaction convinces Darrin that Samantha really loves him. Darrin explains be thought she was posing as Barbara, but leaves Samantha with an uncertain feeling.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: mareTV: Ibiza
programme.desc: The light of the Balearic island of Ibiza is magical and its trademark: The "Island of Light" is tiny compared to its sister island Mallorca, but offers the most beautiful sunsets in the world. That's what they say. They attract sun worshippers and party people from near and far. To the sounds of the famous "Balearic Sound" they turn night into day. This documentary documents the island in the balancing act between luxury yachts and traditions. Hippie culture, celebrities, pine forests, bays with turquoise water and villages with bright white houses: Ibiza has many faces. Mora (80) and Djin (67) have been drawn to the island for 55 years. They are the uncrowned kings of the hippies. But only love, light, air and laziness, these times are also long gone on Ibiza. Mora knits sexy jerseys for young hippies from morning till night. Djin helps her sell at the famous Las Dalias hippie market and works as a construction worker: chilling and no pension in sight. The virgin Carmen is the patron saint of the sailors. On her day of honour, a mass is celebrated in the port city of Eivissa. Afterwards, fishermen carry the Virgin through the narrow streets of Ibiza City down to the quay. And then Carmen sets sail. Several places on Ibiza claim to offer the most beautiful sunset in the world: In front of Cala de Benirrás, the sun sinks right next to the iconic rock Cap Benat, which the locals awefully call "God's Finger". The typical soft beats over the sea sound from almost all the bays and provide deep relaxation worldwide under the term "Balearic Sound". Some of the famous DJs are jetting around the globe for huge fees. But in the small beach bars, the Chiringuitos, the island sound is celebrated further. On the beach of Cala Salada the Brit Joe Burnley has the command over a troop of mermaids. The ladies squeeze into the tight mermaid costume for the good cause. With great grace they swim towards yachts that are forbidden to anchor on sea grass meadows. Charming but unyielding, they point out the offence to the captain and crew a creative environmental action to save the endangered Neptune gas, green lung of the sea and habitat for Ibiza's seahorses. The underwater photographer Manu San Felix is also committed to the endangered seahorses. Using a probe, he maps the coastal area around Ibiza and feeds the data into a GPS app. No skipper should be able to say that he didn't even know that his anchor was clawing into Neptune grass. On land, Manu is dedicated to breeding seahorses. His plan: He wants to expose the animals in the Mediterranean to Ibiza and Formentera in order to secure their population. Garages on the beach? Many bays on the island still have Casetas Varadero, boat garages threatened with decay. Fishermen once built them illegally. The picturesque sheds are therefore only tolerated, but may no longer be restored. The 83-year-old Toni Salvado still drives straight out to sea from his garage. In the wetlands during the rutting season, red deer carry out their bitter power struggles until the water around them appears to blister and boil. The Cantabrian mountain range is habitat for around 140 Cantabrian brown bears – Western Europe's greatest bear population. The females wander from place to place in search of food. Adult male bears and steep mountain slopes are a permanent danger for the youngsters. Iridescent blue throats, defending their territorial borders against rivals, appear to observe them. Above the timberline is the Kingdom of the Cantabrian chamois. They share their habitat with the colourful wallcreeper - an extremely rare bird of the tall mountain region. The Asturian fire salamander is the only one of its kind with a complete yellow hue - he hunts his prey on the banks of the countless streams that flow into the Atlantic, which is inhabited by giants from sperm whales to basking sharks, the world's second largest fish. The rugged north has shaped the identity of its inhabitants. The film accompanies a mountain farmer in the Picos de Europa National Park, who still operates traditional livestock farming and a goose barnacle collector on the Costa da Morte, who quite possibly has the world's most dangerous job. Common to both is the fact that neither of them would exchange their homeland for life in the city.

programme.title: Mountains
programme.desc: A mother lynx feeds on freshly caught prey with her cubs, agile chamoix leap along mountain ledges, bee-eaters dig nesting holes in vineyards, black storks bring up their young on narrow ridges. From the rugged peaks of the Alps and the dark woods of the Black Forest to the sandstone cliffs of Saxonian Switzerland, Germany's mountains are home to very special animals. The episode Mountains from the four-part series Wild Germany shows a world full of breath-taking images. We witness the first few days of baby marmots in Alpine meadows, inexperienced and unaware of the dangers lurking outside the den. The opportunity that the golden eagle in the cliff face has been waiting for. Taking to the air, it glides over the steeply sloping pasture. The older marmots recognize the danger and send out shrill alarm whistles. Will the younger marmots heed the warnings in time? It's been more than 150 years since the last lynx was seen in Germany. After a reintroduction project in the Czech Republic, the first big cats crossed the border into the Bavarian forest. Similar projects in the Harz mountains have also brought the lynx back to Northern Germany. Only 30km South of Dresden, majestic table mountains stretch into the sky: Saxonian Switzerland with its unspoilt rocky cliffs and towers. Habitat of peregrine falcons and white-throated dippers, as well as the shy and seldom seen dormouse. The spectacular beauty and diversity of form of the Elbe Sandstone Mountains are unique in Europe. The film shows the magnificence of the mountains in the different seasons and the rich variety of flora and fauna. Unique animal footage rounds off the portrait of landscapes which have much more than just barren rocks to offer.

programme.title: Amazing Iran
programme.desc: For the Iranian Turkmen a wedding is one of most important social events in their culture and is still celebrated according to old nomadic tradition. The Turkmen Steppe, the country of a thousand mountains, is a tribute to the hidden treasure that is Iran. Home to a proud nation with a majestic history, we show the freedom of a nomadic life, encounter the wild nature of the people and discover old traditions like the Turkmen wedding. Breathtaking sceneries create a mysticism that transports viewers into the realm of divinity while exposing a world caught between tradition and modernity - nomadism and sedentarism. Weddings in Iran are primarily arrangements between families and the product of lengthy negotiations. Even though many customs are purely symbolic, they still reflect the great significance as a rite of transition for the newlyweds and their families. The life of the Turkmen housewife revolves around weddings – first her own, later those of her children. Raising healthy, capable daughters and sons searching for possible partners mediating contact negotiating each betrothal with the family of the intended shouldering the wedding arrangements and the observance of customs and traditions – the responsibility for all of that falls to the mother. Though the Turkmen daughters and sons of today do insist on having their say, love, affection, trust and the like are still not the decisive criteria in making a match. The main consideration is not the subjective happiness of the couple but the happiness, stability and honor of each of their families as a whole. So it is still not uncommon for the bride and groom to be virtual strangers on their wedding day. The nuptials as a ritual of transition mark a series of profound changes – especially in the life of the bride. Once married, she leaves her family and her home village to take her new place within the family of the groom.

programme.title: Amazing Isfahan
programme.sub-title: Paradise in the Heart of Iran
programme.desc: Take a look at this natural beauty. Isfahan – the Florence of Persia, the blue pearl of Iran. The city in the heart of Iran is the most charismatic city in the country and often uttered in the same breath as Bagdad, Constantinople or Cairo. The former capital of the Persian Safavid Empire has long since lost the status of cosmopolitan city, but it still radiates a cosmopolitan charm of which the inhabitants are extremely proud. With its Iranian and Persian national consciousness, Isfahan emits a form of comeliness that attracts people near and far. Following the 30-year-old carpet dealer Shanty as he tries to establish a business for himself and his fiancée Nina, we discover the soul of the city with mesmeric shots, intimate portraits and true to life portrayals of daily life. For 120 years his family has been dealing with noble Persian carpets, but Shanty dreams of a modern coffee shop, driven by a youthful eagerness to experiment and with passion for the new. In the cozy little espresso bar on the city's famous Imam Square Shanty's barista conjures up the best créma in Isfahan while Pink Floyd, The Grateful Death and Led Zeppelin boom from the loudspeakers nothing new in Berlin or Paris but almost revolutionary here. In intimate pictures, we accompany the youngest son of an old Isfahan family through his bulging everyday life and see how many young Iranians try to unite the culture and traditions of their country with the present.

programme.title: Bali Spirit

programme.title: Seychelles
programme.desc: A vacation in the Seychelles - or even a wedding? This is the dream for many, especially Germans, who top the guest list at this island archipelago. But the paradise is under threat. We show the beauty of the island, with its rare animal species, happy wedding couples and white beaches. And yet: This is a paradise under threat, you can see the signs of climate change, with broken shorelines and bleached corals. Although the Seychelles has only 0.13 percent of Germany's land area, its new marine reserve is larger than the Federal Republic: A dream for the conservationists, who are supported by the Seychelles government.

programme.title: The Kung Fu Nuns of Kathmandu

programme.title: Iceland
programme.desc: Majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, raging waterfalls, threatening fjords, mighty glaciers, endless lava fields – there is hardly another country in the world that offers as much impressive nature as Iceland, the remote island in the harsh North Sea. The nature in Iceland is immense! Here, the four elements of nature can be experienced as raw and as close-up as practically no other place on Earth. And nowhere on the northern hemisphere can the origin of life, can growth and decay be experienced as dramatically as here. Besides the impressive nature, we get to know the dramatic history of the Viking culture with its nature-influenced mythology and discuss the negative effects of excessive tourism.

programme.desc: Strawberry Shortcake's friends watch her with wide eyes as she everrrrr-so-gently squirts a layer of blueberry smoothie into a tall glass, trying to not disturb the five other multi-colored layers beneath it. It's her tenth attempt to create the world's first Rainbow Smoothie! She has even painted one wall of her café rainbow colors in honor of the soon-to-be new item on the menu. No one dares breathe for fear of spoiling the delicate touch of a master smoothie-squirter at work.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's a busy day at Lemon's salon, a charming place that is more than just a hair salon it's one of favorite places for Strawberry and her friends to relax and socialize. All the girls are getting their hair done for the gala grand opening of Mr. Longface's new lawn-bowling and croquet club. They're spirited and laughing and chatting and having a great time, as Lemon runs from one of her friends to the next, doing hair and nails, serving tea and cookies.

The two girls help Jadeybug, a postal clerk, and Postmaster Bee gather up the strewn letters and the ill bee gets sent home from work.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While rehearsing a song alone in her cafe, Strawberry is interrupted by the arrival of Jadeybug. The poor ladybug is stressed out because her twin cousins, Kadiebug and Sadiebug, left her a message that they are coming to visit for a whole week. Jadey is unable to host them because she's having her guest room repainted.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While at Orange's general store to pick up a package, Berrykin Bloom chats with Orange about the pogostick he gave her to help her reach the upper shelves. She is very appreciative. He ends up getting a package of special berry seeds he ordered, not the vacation magazine Orange thought he came for. programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Plum decides to hold a dance recital at Strawberry's Café Cabaret stage and sends out a stack of invitations. programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry opens her front door to a throng of Berrykins all cheering for the new BerryFest Princess. programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

The girls turn to her for direction and she points them where she thinks the berry might be.

programme.title: Winds Of Change
programme.desc: Kai promises to watch over Lloyd when Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain– but when Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission... only to discover it's a trap from a GHOST who's escaped the Cursed Realm. After the Ninja save a small fishing village, Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain but Kai promises to watch over him. When Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission... only it's a trap from a GHOST who's escaped the Cursed Realm. When the Ninja's powers mysteriously disappear, they return to the Tea Farm and are attacked by Lloyd, who is possessed by the spirit of Moro, the Master of Wind! After a harrowing escape on the Bounty, Wu tells the Ninja they weren't his first pupils!

programme.title: Ghost Story
programme.desc: When Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja – and the Ninja discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, leaving them to crash. When the dust settles, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja. They discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. In order to save Lloyd and get their powers back, they set off to find the first clue – the scroll to the lost martial art of ‘Airjitzu'. On their way to get it, they have a run in with one of Moro's ghost generals Wraythe, and discover water is the key to stopping them. Meanwhile, Nya discovers a family secret – her mother was a Water Ninja and with training, she could be one too.

programme.title: Saturday Knight Fever
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters catching a cold means trouble for the NEXO-Knights when he can create an entirely new kind of “snotty” monster. King and Queen Halbert have journeyed to the town of Cleanington to open the brand new Scrubbery Barn at the invitation of Roger the Scrubber (seen in 104.) Meanwhile, the Book of Monsters drags Jestro to Snottingham – one of the coldest places in Knighton where everyone coughs, has a runny nose and is generally under-the-weather. The BOM demands that Jestro feed him a “snotheiser” ball which will probably make him sick. The BOM explains that if he is sick, he may just produce a whole new breed of magical monsters … some that the knights would NEVER expect. The BOM gets sick and starts coughing up phlegm globlins and bloblins. The Knights arrive, alerted to what they think is an attack on the town by Snottingham's mayor, Hack Coughmeier. The sickened, sneezy, snotty monsters infect the knights and, more importantly, the knights' NEXO-Shields. Now their NEXO-Powers are infected. As they try to download something to fight the monsters, they realize the powers they get are off strange, infected versions of their powers. The knights drive Jestro and his snot monsters off and they turn in for the night. And, overnight, they all get sick. Meanwhile, the BOM order a nice, hot lava bath…he'll feel fine by morning. But the knights wake-up with colds and they feel terrible. Ava and Merlok 2.0 thinks it will pass in a day or two…it's just a typical Snottingham cold. Each knight gets sick in their own funny way and their illnesses play right into Jestro and the BOM's hands: they're headed to Cleanington to kidnap the king! The citizens of the ultra-clean city hate the sight of monsters, but then feel caught in between when the sick, sneezy, snotty knights arrive on their Fortrex. The fight goes terribly for the knights. They try to download the Nexo-power “Glorious Griffon” but instead get just feathers. So they improvise and tickle the monsters! Ava finally comes up with a way to use some anti-virus tools on their NEXO-Shields and just as Jestro is about to take the king and queen away, the NEXO-Knights get their normal powers back! They defeat Jestro and save the king and queen.

programme.title: Open Mike Knight
programme.desc: The Book of Betrayal leads Jestro and his Monsters to Funnyton – the funnies town in the kingdom. When they Knights arrive to capture him, they discover (to their shock) that Jestro and the Book of Monsters are now the town's top comedians! Jestro and his monsters are in attack formation moving to pillage the town of Funnyton. But when they arrive, ready to tear into the place, they see that nobody's in town. Then, they hear…laughter?! The entire town is there listening to a stand-up comic JOKES KNIGHTLY. He's hilarious. He commands such power, such attention, and such loyalty. Jestro and the BOM decide they must become funny. They order all kinds of book on comedy from Spamazon: books on parody, irony, insult humor, slapstick, satire, knock-knock jokes, elephant jokes, “my monster is so fat” jokes, etc. They work-up a ventriloquist act with the BOM sitting on Jestro's lap. They start doing their act and, surprisingly, they're funny. They're very funny. The Fortrex arrives and the knights rush out, ready for battle. They fight through a string of monsters just outside the town, but discover they're only working as “bouncers” to keep too many people out of the comedy club. (“Sorry, you guys aren't on the list.”) The knights hear loud laughs and head there. In the club, they discover the town isn't being held hostage, they're in the show voluntarily having a great time. And…Jestro and the BOM are funny. Meanwhile, during the show, Jokes Knightly decides he'll steal the BOM and Jestro's act. During the intermission at the comedy show, Clay comes backstage to talk to Jestro. Maybe, Clay says, this shows that Jestro doesn't have to be bad…he is funny, like Clay always said he was. Meanwhile, Jokes Knightly steals the BOM and Jestro can't find it. He panics. Clay encourages him…go on stage alone, be funny…he can do it! Jestro goes out and is funny on his own he hits all his punchlines, he gets big laughs he starts to see that Clay is right. The BOM sees that Jokes Knightly has a “joke book” that turns out to be the BOOK OF BETRAYAL. That's how Mike Knight has become so funny – by stealing everyone's material! BOM calls in Magmar, who saves him from Mike Knight AND takes the Book of Betrayal. As Jestro comes off-stage to great applause, the BOM tells him they have the Book of Betrayal. The BOM calls in Magmar and his monsters and they start a fight as Clay comes to Jestro's defense and calls on the other Knights for backup. A big battle ensues that destroys the comedy club in Funnyton. The Knights win and drive-off Magmar, the monsters and the BOM. As they retreat, the BOM looks around: “Where's my Jestro?!” Jestro sneaked away during the fight and is in a nearby forest with…the Book of Betrayal.

programme.title: The Fortrex And The Furious
programme.desc: In a massive chase around Knighton, the NEXO-Knights attempt to keep the Book of Betrayal out of the Book of Monster's grip. But the evil book is persistent. Will he get the final piece of his evil puzzle? We finally REVEAL that Jestro has given the Book of Betrayal to…Clay. He tells Clay what it is and how Mike Knight used it. And it seems that the Book of Monsters believed it to be the final ingredient in some ‘Master Plan.” Suddenly, they realize Monsters – led by Magmar and the super-mad Book of Monster – are after them! Clay retreats with Jestro and the Book of Betrayal to rendezvous with the other Knights at the Fortrex. The Fortrex isn't fast enough they'll need their own vehicles. They decide that they need to split up and go in multiple directions to make the monsters expend their resources on a chase. It's a huge chase, being covered like a crazy news event by the Knighton News Network. We see a montage of the monsters stopping and capturing all the Knights vehicles: Aaron, Macy, Lance…finally Axl. However, as they do, they realize that the Knights have used Squirebots in Jestro Fan Jester hats (from the vendor at the comedy club in 108) as decoys. They think Axl has the Book of Betrayal in his BRICK containment unit, but it turns out to be the Ned Knightly Comic from episode 203. The Monsters finally corner Clay, who has the real Jestro and Book of Betrayal in his sword vehicle. Before Clay can protest, Jestro pushes the launch button and fires off Clay in the vehicle's rocket sword. The monsters race off with Jestro, leaving the shocked Clay fearing for his friend. Now, Magmar tells the Book of Monsters, they only need to get BOB. Clay makes his way back to the Fortrex and tells what has happened. They decide they must get to the Redoubt of Ruination in the Lava Lands and try to save Jestro. Meanwhile, we see, INTERCUT, a scene where Merlok 2.0 and the Book of Monsters explain the Books of Evil, how they were created and what the BOM will use them for. Merlok, back in the day, split the evil MONSTRUX into 10 magic books to keep him from ever being a threat. Only, he didn't destroy the books…and now the BOM has them and Monstrux can come back into the world! Meanwhile, the BOM has set up the huge, ceremonial arena at their HQ so they can have the ceremony to bring Monstrux back into the world. Jestro realizes he's been a pawn of the Book of Monsters. Jestro says he'll never get the Book of Betrayal…the Knights have it. In the last scene, we see Clay taking the Book of Betrayal from the Fortrex, climbing into his vehicle and driving towards…the Redoubt of Ruination! Has the Book of Betrayal worked its evil magic on him?!

programme.title: Kingdom Of Heroes
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters, having the final pieces of his evil plan in place, tries to take human form. Can the NEXO-Knights and Merlok 2.0 stop the greatest threat they've ever faced? Or will the kingdom be plunged into darkness…forever. The Redoubt of Ruination readies the final ceremony to call forth MONSTRUX, the arch-necromancer of the past. Clay, holding the Book of Betrayal walks to the gates of the spooky place. Inside, Clay hears strange…singing and music. It's like a twisted Broadway show of some kind. Meanwhile, the Knights all realize Clay is gone and so is the Book of Betrayal. Macy says Clay must be up to something. They have to trust him and, more importantly, they have to find him. At the Redoubt of Ruination the ceremony has already begun! The Book of Monsters wants the final ceremony that calls forth Monstrux to be like a really great show! The BOM then barfs up all the BOOKS OF EVIL into their places around Jestro. He's just missing the BOOK OF BETRAYAL, which Clay has. Clay says he'll trade the book for Jestro. The BOM immediately agrees to the deal and sets Jestro free. Then, Monsters grab-up Clay, restrain him, and put him in Jestro's place on the sacrifice stone. From outside, they're interrupted by the sounds of battle the Knights have arrived on the Fortrex and are attacking the Redoubt of Ruination. In the confusion, Jestro slips away. The BOM lets loose with a powerful protection spell to keep the Knights out as he starts with the ceremony…he's going to bring Monstrux out and remanifest him in Clay's body! Jestro is able to escape the Redoubt and make his way to the Knights, who can't seem to battle their way in. It's a race against time as the Knights try to get in and save Clay. As the Knights get in, they see that the crazy BOM is absorbing all the Books of Evil, one-by-one. He grows BIGGER and BIGGER! Macy calls for NEXO-Power…but it's not enough! The gigantic Book of Monsters sucks down the final book, the Book of Betrayal! He looms over Clay, about to consume him, too, and make him into Monstrux! Suddenly, Robin appears carrying TECHKALIBER…he tosses it to Clay. Just as the huge Book of Monsters falls on Clay, he holds up Techkaliber and Merlok 2.0 is there…his full power in the sword. Clay sticks the sword into the Book of Monster's huge mouth. BOOM! There's a BIG, MAGICAL EXPLOSION! As we cut back inside, we see the Book of Monsters is gone. The Knights release Clay and he thanks them and Jestro for saving him. Jestro thanks them all for saving him and seeing the good in him. WE DISSOLVE TO: The JoustDome. In a final ceremony the King and Queen reward the knights and congratulate them for keeping the kingdom safe. There are speeches, happiness and friendship. And Jestro even does a bit that's funny. At the very end we see a hint of something…Monstrux and the Book of Monsters are still out there.

programme.desc: Logan's desperation to prove himself leads to his capture by the Nightmare King, which leaves his friends to face the Sheep Week finals alone.

programme.title: The Grim Escape

programme.title: Prophecy Of The Green Ninja, Greatest Battles
programme.desc: So the final puzzle forces ninja to question the true meaning of the Green Ninja Prophecy. Solving the puzzles releases a new peril for the Ninja to face. Will memories of their greatest victories be enough to defeat it?

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Martin Sheen plays Tom, an American doctor who comes to France to collect the remains of his adult son who was killed in the Pyrenees in a storm while walking The Camino de Santiago - also known as 'The Way of Saint James'. Driven by his desire to understand his lost son, Tom decides to embark on the historical pilgrimage, leaving his California life behind. Armed only with his son's backpack and guidebook, he begins the 800km historical pilgrimage but soon discovers that he won't be alone on this journey - he meets other pilgrims from around the world, all broken and looking for greater meaning in their lives. From the hardship experienced along "The Way" an unlikely group of misfits are bonded and Tom begins to learn the difference between 'The life we live and the life we choose.'

programme.title: Waiting for Anya
programme.desc: From the mind of world-renowned author Michael Morpurgo comes the cinematic adaptation of Waiting for Anya - a powerful and authentic true story of a young shepherd that had a key part to play in one of the world's most shocking moments in history. Based on the novel by the author of War Horse, Waiting for Anya follows the story of Jo Lalande, a thirteen-year-old shepherd living in the mountain village of Lescun. Though Europe may be ravaged by the horrors of World War II, Jo's world in the French Pyrenees has remained remarkably untouched. That is, until a ferocious encounter with a bear introduces Jo to the mysterious Benjamin, a Jewish refugee who is desperately awaiting the arrival of his missing daughter, Anya, before making his escape across the border. Making friends with Benjamin and his mother-in-law Horcada, an isolated widow who lives in the nearby mountains, Jo becomes aware of a very dangerous secret - the family are involved in smuggling Jewish children over the mountains to the safety of Spain. In a heroic act of defiance, Jo promises to assist Benjamin in his endeavours...but soon becomes embroiled in a perilous conspiracy when German troops make their descent upon the village. Filmed in the village of Lescun and the surrounding Aspe Valley, France in which the true to life story also originated, the film boasts an all-stellar cast including Noah Schnapp (Stranger Things), Academy Award Winner Anjelica Huston (Ever After, The Addams Family), Jean Reno (Leon, The Big Blue, Ronin), Frederick Schmidt (Mission: Impossible - Fallout), Thomas Kretschmann (The Pianist, Central Intelligence) and Nicholas Rowe (Riviera, Lock Stock and Two Smoking Barrels).

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Sharmeela meets Indravdhan in private and learns that the latter has no interest in talking with her. While Gayatri, on the other hand, eavesdrops on Sharmeela and Indravdhan's conversation. Indravadhan insults Sharmeela in his casual talks and walks away. Gayatri's sister-in-laws decides to tail her and find out as to who is the person that Gayatri is so fond off. Before Gayatri's sister-in-laws could reach Gayatri, Indravadhan orders one of his men to give a drink to the woman standing upstairs. The man finds Gayatri to be upstairs and gives her the drink claiming that Indravadhan asked her to have it. The drink that Gayatri consumes seems to be an alcoholic drink. What would be the result of this act? Keep watching to find out.Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal, but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri's sister-in-laws learn that Gayatri is drunk and yet they get her to drink more of the alcoholic beverage. In a drunk state, Gayatri sets off to talk with Indravadhan but she meets another man and he tells her that he isn't Indravadhan. Later, Gaytri's mother also realizes that she is drunk and tries to hide this news from her husband. Gayatri's mother secretively takes Gayatri home in the car and asks her husband and sons to reach home in the Tonga. While Gopal Seth is about to leave the Ameerkot, he learns that his Tonga has been seized by Chandravadhan. Later, when Gopal Seth reaches home in a frustrated state and learns that Gayatri is drunk. programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Maata Ki Mahima
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: Janani
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Crime Files
programme.desc: It All Begins Around Us This Crime Show Explores Crimes That Occur Within Our Own Communities And Among People We Know. programme.title: POSTMASTER
programme.desc: Postmaster is a social drama that is based on the life of ups and downs of a closely knit joint family, residing in rural Bengal, before the time of Freedom. Our main protagonist is shown to be a maverick in all sense, trying to bring about the change of education and free thought into the limited mind-space of the controlling and judgemental society that he is in. The movie deals with many issues such as patriarchy and all its ill effects, woman subjugation and dominance, inequal rights and freedom constraints played on women and the likes. It explores themes of relationships, the expectations of family on the shoulders of the new generation, and the troubles and pains of the weak, poor and misfortunate. The movie has been very well thought out, with a gripping storyline. All characters, especially our lead, Ratna, Kumar, Abani, Nando and the rest who make the movie worth watching. It ends on a happy and good note, where all problems are resolved and there is peace and balance in the system.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.10
programme.desc: After discovering that Jeongi is a woman, Gwanghae urges her to flee at once. Instead, Jeongi asks for just ten days—enough time to complete the celadon teacups for Yukdo. Hearing rumors that Jeongi and Gwanghae share more than a simple connection, Imhae devises a scheme and locks the two of them together in a single room.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.11
programme.desc: Gwanghae orders Gangcheon to acknowledge Jeongi's achievements and reinstate her at the Bunwon workshop. Soon after, he learns from Hwa-ryeong that Jeongi has already left with Taedo—and discovers the shocking truth that the two are not actually biological siblings. When Yukdo's life is placed in danger, Gangcheon reveals to King Seonjo and the visiting envoy that it was Jeongi who crafted the teacups. As Taedo prepares to confess his feelings to Jeongi, Gwanghae suddenly appears…

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.12
programme.desc: While Gwanghae meets with the envoy, Taedo rescues Jeongi from the warehouse where she has been locked away. Watching Jeongi and Taedo walk off together, Gwanghae is flooded with memories from his past. Taedo warns Jeongi that if she chooses not to be entangled with Gwanghae any longer, she must never allow her true identity as “Jeongi” to be revealed. Back at the Bunwon, Jeongi begins learning the potter's wheel under Yukdo's guidance…

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.13
programme.desc: Consumed by anger, Gwanghae coldly tells Jeongi that she is no longer the person he once knew—and that she has nothing to do with him anymore. Left in tears as she gazes at the pottery she has made, Jeongi vows to earn Gwanghae's forgiveness. Meanwhile, in front of everyone at the Bunwon, Gangcheon orders that Euldam's vessels be destroyed…

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.14
programme.desc: After defeating Yukdo, Jeongi meets Gangcheon's gaze with quiet confidence, leaving him visibly shaken when he learns that her family name is “Yu.” Meanwhile, the Chief Scholar presents Gwanghae with a vessel he claims was a bribe from Royal Consort Inbin. Seeking the truth, Gwanghae visits the royal artisan Mun Saseung to confirm whether the piece was made at the Bunwon—just as Jeongi steps inside.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.15
programme.desc: Unable to bring herself to shatter Euldam's vessel, Jeongi trembles before Gangcheon until Gwanghae arrives to intervene. Determined to prove himself superior to Mun Saseung, Yukdo demands a chance from Gangcheon. Jeongi agrees to assist Mun Saseung in crafting the ceremonial vessels for the Giroyeon banquet. Watching Gwanghae's special concern for Jeongi, Taedo questions why she matters to him so deeply.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the R&B quintet FROM ALL TO HUMAN! Composed of vocalist Blesssing guitarist PARK JAE WOO bassist NAM WOO SEOK keyboardist MOON SUNG HWAN and drummer MOON SEONG HO this band brought a new wave of R&B to the Korean music scene upon their debut in 2017. With their band's name referring to a journey “from all beings to humans” the five hope to develop every day as musicians. True to their name they are evolving and developing every day winning the Grand Prize at the 2019 Shinhan Card Rookie Project and the TOP2 at KT&G's SangSang Madang Band Discovery Competition in 2019. From acid jazz to R&B to new jack swing the quintet covers a wide range of genres in their music backed up by solid storylines which makes them truly one of a kind. In this episode FROM ALL TO HUMAN performs Dizzy Oriental chill Don't be disappointed and more to showcase the quintessence of their musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these five genuine musicians!
